purpose: Teach: 断ら/就い/傘下/綿密/総論/凝らし/辛抱/リストアップ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者に黙秘権を断られた場合の手順も整えられますね
lines.en: So the police even have procedures ready for when a suspect invokes their right to silence and refuses to talk.
lines.style: Attentive opening, respectful measured pace, a small rise of genuine interest at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新任の課長が役職に就いた事を組織内で共有されますね
lines.en: And when a new section chief takes up the post, word goes out through the whole organization, doesn't it.
lines.style: Even, polite observation, nodding rhythm, careful not to sound like he's prying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地方警察、つまり傘下の所轄と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: You run joint investigations with the local forces too — the precinct stations under your umbrella, I mean.
lines.style: Thinking aloud, brief self-correcting pause mid-sentence, closing on an impressed hum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料を綿密に整理されますね
lines.en: And the investigation files get organized so meticulously.
lines.style: Quiet admiration, volume dipping softer, slowing on 'meticulously' to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査報告書の総論を、警察、明確にされますね
lines.en: The overview section of the investigation report — you keep that crystal clear as well.
lines.style: Measured respectful phrasing, gentle emphasis on the key term, seeking confirmation with a lift.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場検証に工夫を凝らした手法も使われますね
lines.en: For the on-site inspections you even bring in these carefully devised techniques, don't you.
lines.style: Leaning-in fascination, a touch faster, real curiosity breaking through the office politeness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長期捜査には辛抱、つまり辛抱強さも必要ですね
lines.en: And a long investigation must take patience — real, dogged perseverance.
lines.style: Thoughtful exhale first, slower sympathetic delivery, quiet weight on 'perseverance'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者リストアップを、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: So even drawing up the list of suspects — that's all done with real care, then.
lines.style: Closing summary tone, quiet and conclusive, a small respectful bow audible in the cadence.
